newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia sets election for decisive parliament seat.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia sets election for decisive parliament seat.

text.p: Mongolia's Election Committee on Wednesday said an election would be held on August 17 to fill the seat left vacant after President Natsagiin Bagabandi was inaugurated in June.

A victory for the ruling Democratic Union Coalition could be crucial since it holds 50 seats in the 76-seat Great Hural, or parliament, just one short of the two-thirds majority it needs to override a presidential veto. However, the constituency of 15,590 voters in western Mongolia's Zavkhan province is a traditional stronghold of the opposition formerly communist Mongolian People's Revolutionary Party (MPRP), on whose ticket the new president ran for election.
Candidates must register in the 10 days from July 14 for the August 17 election, an Election Committee spokesman told a news conference.
